Name: Stay Hydrated
Author: NatrollEXE
Description:
So... my [color=#ffffff]mom[/color] reminds me to drink water so often that I decided to make this mod and share the reminder with all of you too 🤔🫪

This mod adds a glass and a bottle of ice-cold water to the game. Drink some water to restore energy and gain a temporary [b][color=#3d85c6]Freshness[/color][/b] buff that helps you spend less energy while using tools.

[b][color=#00ffff]Freshness Buff[/color][/b]
[list]
[*][b][color=#3d85c6]Glass of Iced Water:[/color][/b] +1 Freshness for 2 minutes and 5% less energy spent when using tools.[/*]
[*][b][color=#3d85c6]Bottle of Iced Water[/color]:[/b] +2 Freshness for 4 minutes and 10% less energy spent when using tools.[/*]
[/list][b][color=#00ffff]How to Get Water[/color][/b]
[list]
[*]Buy bottles from [b]Gus for 50g[/b] or [b]Pierre for 100g[/b].[/*]
[*]Collect a free glass of water from sinks using a configurable keyboard, mouse, or controller button.[/*]
[/list][b][color=#00ffff]Weather Wonders Integration[/color][/b]

If Weather Wonders is installed, drinking water during a heatwave protects you from the intense heat while the Freshness buff is active.
It prevents both the maximum-energy penalty and the continuous energy drain caused by the heat. Both drinks provide full protection, the bottle simply lasts longer.

[b][color=#00ffff]Requirements[/color][/b]
[list]
[*]SMAPI[/*]
[*]Content Patcher[/*]
[*]Tile Marker 1.1.0 or later (Required for getting water from the sink.)[/*]
[*]Generic Mod Config Menu (To configure the sink interaction button in-game)[/*]
[/list][url=https://github.com/SheilaEXE/StardewValleyMods/tree/main/Stay-Hydrated][b]Source Code[/b][/url]

[center][quote][left][i]Before making this mod, the only pixel art I had ever drawn was the little blush puff that appears above your romantic partner’s head in my Lots of Kisses mod.[/i][/left]
[left][i]So after finishing these water sprites, I was genuinely really happy with how they turned out. It may be a very small step, but I think they ended up looking really cute, and that means a lot to me  (ﾉω･､)[/i][/left]
[/quote][/center]
